notes: Level 1 explicit continuation opens a dedicated LEVEL 2 player/Alex conversation. Its final reading interval completes before the game automatically opens metric selection; no additional navigation action is introduced.

The introduction holds while hidden or under the restart modal, restarts with a new level run and retains the host-provided name. Name handoff remains compatible with both placeholder and partner scene renderers.

Alex’s Checklist consistently names the vertical selection summary and later 10/25/100 action lists. Selection marks mean chosen metrics. Neither the three- nor six-metric evaluation duplicates that checklist.

Both levels render one shared LearningRisk component and stylesheet, with an observed behaviour as the main text and a small Learning at risk label. All six Level 1 branch descriptions are checked against the corresponding classroom evidence.

A normal-motion browser check confirms that the untracked-area border keeps animating beyond two seconds, repeats indefinitely and changes border colour while leaving text in place. The 1.8-second animation ends when the missing metrics are added. Reduced motion uses the existing static-animation override.
The Level 2 regression, Level 1 smoke and feedback checks use real presentation intervals. Partner-host, name-integration and packaged-release checks advance reading waits with the browser clock.

Both entries in the downloadable ZIP match the production build bytes and pass an offline browser flow. Managed Chromium blocks file navigation, so direct local-file opening in the user browser was not observed.
All 20 three-metric combinations, six Level 1 branches, responsive layouts, keyboard controls, sound, restart, hidden-tab holds and fresh-page lifetime passed their functional checks.
Student warnings interpret the demonstrated story behaviour, without inventing measured learning loss or a declining student score.

The teammate’s opening and finished classroom cinematics are still separate. Three/six-item physical checklist actions remain represented by cinematic placeholders; completed partner scenes and Level 3 are outside this build.
